meta.description: Registry for cross-system stability failure modes and instability propagation conditions in Phase 2 of the Mono-Process Formal Law Program.

failure_modes.name: recursive_divergence
failure_modes.description: System state grows without bound or fails to reach a stable recurrence basin under iteration.

failure_modes.name: branch_explosion
failure_modes.description: The number of active continuation branches grows non-summahbly, preventing stable flux analysis.

failure_modes.name: orientation_drift
failure_modes.description: Local orientation frame deviates persistently from the global reference frame under transport or composition.

failure_modes.name: equivalence_collapse_instability
failure_modes.description: Erratic or inconsistent merging of formal objects into equivalence classes.

failure_modes.name: transport_closure_failure
failure_modes.description: Transport operators map states outside all declared admissibility windows.

failure_modes.name: projection_aliasing_instability
failure_modes.description: Forward projection erases critical process information required for stable recursion.

failure_modes.name: residue_feedback_instability
failure_modes.description: Residue updates create unconstrained positive feedback loops in continuation selection.

failure_modes.name: reconstruction_ambiguity_explosion
failure_modes.description: Preimage ambiguity grows non-linearly, preventing unique or equivalence-class-based reconstruction.

failure_modes.name: nonlocal_instability_propagation
failure_modes.description: Instability in one local transport neighborhood propagates non-locally across the CSI domain.

failure_modes.name: stability_metric_undefined
failure_modes.description: Stability cannot be analyzed due to missing or unresolved formal metrics.
